fr_html: M. DE LAPRADELLE exprime l'avis que le Comité pourrait se rallier à l'idée de Mr. Root, sauf rédaction.
en_html: M. DE LAPRADELLE expressed the opinion that the Committee could adopt M. Root's idea, which would however have to be put in writing.
